title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
layout_note: Panel (a) on the left is the diagram; panel (b) on the right is the algorithm box (rules above and below, bold keywords, math-italic symbols), so the figure pairs a loop diagram with its pseudocode at equal height.
grouping: A single large light-grey square-cornered container titled 'Agent' in bold holds every learned component; the Environment is a separate grey box below and outside it. Components split into two colour families: language-model roles (Self-reflection, Evaluator, Actor, each suffixed '(LM)') in blue-grey, memories (Trajectory as short-term memory, Experience as long-term memory) in pale yellow.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin dark outlines, no shadows; sans-serif labels with the memory type in parentheses on a second line. Thin dark orthogonal arrows with small heads; the outer agent-environment loop runs as elbowed lines from the Actor out the right edge to the Environment (labelled Action) and back up the left edge (labelled Obs / Reward) into Trajectory and Self-reflection. Arrow labels in plain small text: External feedback, Internal feedback, Reflective text.
proposed_highlight: No colour accent for the method itself; the contribution shows as the extra inner loop (Trajectory to Evaluator to Self-reflection to Experience to Actor) drawn inside the Agent container above the classic Action / Obs-Reward loop, and the memory boxes stand out by their warm yellow against the cool model boxes.
lesson: Draw the agent as one large container and the environment as a box outside it, close the classic loop with Action / Obs-Reward elbow arrows around the container, and colour the boxes by kind: model roles in one cool tint, short- and long-term memory in one warm tint.
notes: elements 'other' = the algorithm panel (b) set as pseudocode beside the diagram. Venue NeurIPS from semantic-scholar; year 2023 is both the arXiv year and the recorded venue year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
